content:
maria_support: FYI - multiple SG1 hosted inference customers reporting 504/timeouts + intermittent 5xx since ~07:40 SGT. Customer ticket #24682 opened, escalation to P1. Observability shows gateway latency spike and retransmits. :rotating_light:
observability-bot: ALERT: region=sg1 edge_gateway 504_rate=18% (07:40-07:46) p50_token_latency=320ms p95=1.2s. Tracebacks show upstream conn resets. https://obs.internal/redwood/alerts/24682
tim_sre: On it. Can you drop one or two request IDs and a sample error payload here? Also which customers impacted (org ids)?
maria_support: sending IDs + orgs 

maria_support: ```
request_id: 0a3f9b2e
org: prod-acme
error: upstream gateway 504
retries: 3
http: POST /v1/generate 504
log: "read tcp 10.2.1.5:443: connection reset by peer"
```
lee_netops: Seeing BGP withdraws from transit ASN 64512 -> sg1-pop at 07:41:12, 07:41:45, 07:42:10 followed by re-advertise. ECMP path jitter + ~5-12% packet loss on provider path during window. Traceroute sample: ```
traceroute to 203.0.113.45 (203.0.113.45), 12 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.1.0.1  0.6 ms 0.5 ms 0.6 ms
 2  198.51.100.1  6.8 ms 6.7 ms 6.9 ms
 3  * * *   (intermittent replies)
 4  203.0.113.1  18.2 ms 200 ms 19.3 ms
```
lee_netops: Looks like provider-side microbursts + BGP route flapping causing retransmits and gateway timeouts. I've opened ticket with transit provider (ref TP-9981). ping shows 10-12% loss during spike.
transit-provider-bot: TP-9981: We observed a misconfigured peering session causing flap between our session and a downstream IX peer. Applying route dampening now. ETA for stabilization ~8-12 minutes.
ashley_eng: Are these hitting our public gateway layer or the inference dedicated pool? If public gateway, we can programmatically fail traffic over to an alternate peer or route to eu-sg edge for affected customers. Any auth errors reported?
sam_billing: Heads-up - this spike caused some customers to consume retries; we should hold billing for retry tokens for impacted orgs until postmortem.
jordan_cs: Customer on real-time SLA, they're asking for ETA and whether we can provide mitigation now. They're trying to replay a job and keep timing out.
maria_support: Told them we're working on provider failover and will follow up in 15m. Offering temporary credits.
tim_sre: Quick mitigation plan: 1) push BGP prepref to alternate upstream for sg1 2) increase gateway proxy timeouts to absorb transient reorders 3) route affected orgs to dedicated pool if they have one. I'll run the commands now.
ashley_eng: +1. Also adding short-term retries with exponential backoff in gateway to avoid hammering.
lee_netops: Pushed more-specific prepref to Peer-B at 07:48:05. Provider applied dampening at 07:50:12. BGP withdraws subsided. Packet loss back under 1%.
observability-bot: UPDATE: region=sg1 edge_gateway 504_rate=1.2% (07:50-07:56) p50=95ms p95=210ms. Error budget impact reduced.
tim_sre: Can everyone add whether any customers still see errors? Jordan - can you confirm with the customer?
jordan_cs: Customer confirmed degraded but functional since ~07:51. They've accepted temporary credits and asked for PM.
ashley_eng: Repro steps + workaround to add to ticket: 
1) curl --header "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -v
2) if you see 504/gateway, retry with 1) 200ms jittered backoff x3 and 2) set header `Prefer: reroute=alternate` to use alternate-peer routing (internal feature flag)
Config snippet (gateway override): ```json
{"gateway_timeout_ms":9000, "retry_policy": {"max_attempts":3, "backoff_ms":200}}
```
maria_support: Closing immediate customer loop. Creating P0 postmortem and tagging network + runtime teams. Action items: network follow-up with provider ticket TP-9981, gate config tweak log, and billing credit for org prod-acme. I'll attach logs/timelines.
sam_billing: I'll put credit hold on prod-acme and prod-beta until postmortem complete.
observability-bot: Incident thread closed for now, but metrics will continue to be monitored. Please add any follow-ups to PR-5021 (postmortem)
maria_support: Thanks all :white_check_mark:
